text: Get Aimparency used by outside developers and collect their feedback
description: The repo is public (ISC) but has 0 stars, 0 user interviews and no outside users; Build Week showed a legible user benefit matters. Lower the entry cost (zero-setup init in any repo, importing existing GitHub issues), reach a first cohort of about five external repositories, and capture their feedback in the graph. Also supplies the user evidence the Prototype Fund application lacks (user-research kit exists, tracker empty).

supportingConnections.hypothesis: Seeing a real graph from a URL in seconds is the cheapest first contact for a new user.
